title: A site network missing from TRACY-FLEET-EGRESS after a reboot is enrolled and persisted by the host timer
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/egress-enroll.test.mjs
S2: Record the exit code and the '# tests', '# pass', '# fail' lines.
expect: A lost 10.240.x site network is enrolled and the ruleset saved; non-site networks untouched; a failed save or missing chain exits non-zero; bootstrap.sh installs and enables tracy-egress-enroll.timer; provision.sh no longer swallows a failed save.
evidence: 21/11/2026 kernel reboot of both DO fleet hosts: 12 production and 20 dev site networks were outside TRACY-FLEET-EGRESS because provision.sh's netfilter-persistent save runs inside tracy-host where the command does not exist.
fence: A site network made by provision stays behind the egress fence across a reboot of the host.

tests: a site network missing from DOCKER-USER after a reboot is enrolled and the ruleset saved
bootstrap installs the script and enables the timer; the timer runs at boot and every 5 minutes
